isolation.profile: Seeded in localStorage via eval (employeeName: Test User, jobTitle: Store Associate, storeName: Test Store, etc.)

assertions.title: Promotion page loads with three-column layout

steps.action: Seed profile in localStorage, navigate to / via React Router, click Promotions link
steps.expected: Promotion page renders with three-column layout
steps.observed: Page renders with a multi-column layout. Left column (promo body details, 40%/512px), skinny sidebar bar (40px) for collapsed center column, center column (email tools, collapsed w-0), right column (live preview, flex-1/727px). The layout implements a toggle pattern where only one form column (left OR center) is visible at a time alongside the always-visible preview column. Default state is left-expanded.

steps.action: Check DOM structure for column elements
steps.observed: Four children in the flex container: left column (DIV, w-[40%]), skinny bar (BUTTON, w-10), center column (DIV, w-0 collapsed), right column (DIV, flex-1). The right column contains the PreviewColumn component with Preview/HTML Code tabs and action buttons.

steps.action: Check for sticky/fixed positioning on right column
steps.observed: No sticky or fixed positioning found on the right column or its children. The right column uses 'flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-hidden' with internal scrolling via Tabs content areas. This is a deviation from the spec but works functionally since the layout uses full viewport height (h-[calc(100vh-3.5rem)]) preventing page scroll.

assertions.issues: Right column is not sticky/fixed as specified. It uses flex-1 within a full-height flex container, which achieves a similar visual effect but is not technically 'sticky/fixed' positioning.

steps.action: View the Basic Details card on the promotion page (left column, default expanded)
steps.expected: Card contains form fields for promotion title, dates, intro text, etc.
steps.observed: Basic Details card contains 3 form fields: Date Range (id: promoDateRange, placeholder: 'Nov 28 - Dec 1'), Year (id: promoYear, placeholder: 'Auto-uses current year'), Title (id: promoTitle, placeholder: 'Leave blank for auto-generation'). Fields are empty since no data is in promotion state.

steps.expected: Card content collapses, only header visible
steps.observed: Card collapses successfully. Content area height becomes 0px. Button text changes to 'Expand Basic Details'.

steps.expected: Card content reappears with form fields
steps.observed: Card expands back. All 3 form fields visible again with same placeholders.

steps.action: Check all 5 left-column cards for status dots (Basic Details, Discount Entries, How to Shop, Important Notes, Special Hours)
steps.expected: Each card has a collapse toggle and a status dot
steps.observed: All 5 left-column cards have status dots (10px circles with 'rounded-full' class) and collapse/expand toggle buttons. Dots use 'inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full transition-colors' styling.

steps.action: Check status dot colors in empty state (before filling data)
steps.expected: Empty sections show different color than filled sections
steps.observed: basicDetailsCard: blue (bg-primary) - has default How to Shop/Important Notes items counted. discountEntriesCard: gray (bg-muted-foreground/30) - empty. howToShopCard: blue (bg-primary) - has default items from initializeDefaultItems(). importantNotesCard: blue (bg-primary) - has default items. specialHoursCard: gray (bg-muted-foreground/30) - empty.

steps.action: Fill Date Range field and add a discount entry with data
steps.expected: Status dots change to filled color
steps.observed: After filling data: basicDetailsCard: blue (bg-primary), discountEntriesCard: blue (bg-primary, changed from gray), howToShopCard: blue (bg-primary), importantNotesCard: blue (bg-primary), specialHoursCard: gray (bg-muted-foreground/30, still empty). Discount Entries dot correctly changed from gray to blue.

assertions.title: Column collapse/expand (skinny bar)

steps.action: View initial state with left column expanded
steps.expected: Left column visible, center column collapsed with skinny bar
steps.observed: Left column: 512px (w-[40%]), Skinny bar: 40px (w-10) with center column card labels, Center column: 1px (w-0, collapsed), Right column: 727px (flex-1).

steps.action: Click 'Expand Email Tools column' skinny bar button
steps.expected: Center column expands, left column collapses with its own skinny bar
steps.observed: Left column: 1px (collapsed), Left skinny bar: 40px (visible), Center column: 384px (w-[30%]), Right column: 855px (flex-1, grew from 727px to 855px).

steps.action: Click 'Expand Promo Body Details column' skinny bar button
steps.expected: Left column expands, center column collapses
steps.observed: Left column: 512px (w-[40%], restored), Center skinny bar: 40px (visible), Center column: 1px (collapsed), Right column: 727px (flex-1, shrank back).

assertions.issues: The collapse/expand works via a toggle pattern where only one form column (left OR center) can be expanded at a time. There is no way to have both form columns visible simultaneously. The preview column width adjusts accordingly (727px ↔ 855px). This is a design choice, not a bug.

assertions.title: Profile redirect on promotion page

steps.action: Clear userProfile from localStorage via eval
Navigate to /promotion via React Router nav link (from /)
steps.expected: Redirect to /start with a banner indicating profile is required
steps.observed: Successfully redirected to http://localhost:8080/start. The router state contains {from: '/promotion'}. However, no banner indicating 'profile is required' is displayed on the /start page. The profile page renders normally without any notification about why the user was redirected.

steps.action: Check for any banner, toast, or notification about profile requirement
steps.expected: A visible banner or message indicating profile is required
steps.observed: No banner, toast, alert, or notification found. The legacy start.html had a 'profileRequiredBanner' div shown via ?return= query param, but the React /start page does not read the router location state to display an equivalent banner.

assertions.issues: The redirect to /start works correctly (React Router <Navigate to='/start' replace state={{from: '/promotion'}} />), but no 'profile required' banner is shown on the /start page. The React Profile page component does not read the location.state.from value to display a notification. The legacy start.html had this feature via a query parameter and a dedicated banner div.

steps.observed: Desktop three-column layout (hidden lg:flex) is hidden. Mobile single-column layout (lg:hidden) is visible. Viewport width confirmed at 768px.

steps.action: Check if skinny bars are hidden
steps.expected: Skinny bars should be hidden on mobile
steps.observed: Skinny bars (hidden lg:flex) are correctly hidden on mobile viewport.

steps.expected: Right column (preview) stacks below form columns
steps.observed: Mobile layout has 3 stacked sections: (1) Left column cards (border-b) - Basic Details, Discount Entries, How to Shop, etc., (2) Center column cards (border-b) - PDF Attachments, Subject Lines, Bulk Email Tools, (3) Right column (min-h-[500px]) - Email Preview with tabs and action buttons. All sections are properly stacked in a single column.

frictions.description: Profile was not pre-seeded in the browser session's localStorage as stated in the isolation context. Had to manually seed it via agent-browser eval before testing the promotion page. This is expected since agent-browser sessions have isolated storage.
frictions.resolution: Used agent-browser eval to set localStorage.setItem('userProfile', JSON.stringify({...})) with a valid profile object matching the UserProfile interface.

summary: Tested 6 assertions: 5 passed, 1 failed (VAL-PROMO-021: profile redirect works but no 'profile required' banner is displayed on the /start page). VAL-PROMO-001 passes with a note that the right column uses flex layout rather than sticky/fixed positioning, but achieves the same visual effect. VAL-PROMO-020 passes with a note that only one form column can be visible at a time (toggle pattern).
